summary: For A_n=R_n diag(1,1,-1) R_n^T with the full-spark trigonometric Parseval frame, the nonzero spectrum is exactly {1,1,-1}. Every exact scalar-sufficient original-coordinate bank is a singleton, and every resulting clean density-normalized three-scalar core has sigma_min<=9/n and determinant magnitude<=27/n^3. Thus leakage-free clean tribank extraction with a universal core scale is false even in the indefinite target. This is not a QFORM counterexample: for n>=96 the completed ridge-window theorem bounds the full output density by <64 and proves continuity. Exact signed leakage currency is EE^T=G-M^2.
